title: The Russian Revolution
dek: Of how the Bolsheviks took the capital, and turned the state against the Church.
body: On the night of 25 October 1917 (7 November, new style) the Bolsheviks seized Petrograd; the Winter Palace fell in the small hours.

panels.label: Church and State
panels.text: An early-1918 decree stripped the Church of legal standing and property and ended religious teaching in schools.

panels.label: The Patriarch
panels.text: Tikhon, elected patriarch in 1917, excommunicated the Soviet leaders in January 1918. He was arrested in 1922.

panels.label: St Isaac's
panels.text: Stripped of its furnishings after 1917, the cathedral became a Museum of the History of Religion and Atheism in 1931.
